people_gender_check.name: people_gender_check

people_birth_day_check.name: people_birth_day_check
people_birth_day_check.value: birth_day IS NULL OR birth_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31

people_birth_year_check.name: people_birth_year_check
people_birth_year_check.value: birth_year IS NULL OR birth_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100

people_archived_reason_check.name: people_archived_reason_check

people_merge_consistency.name: people_merge_consistency

hierarchy_nodes_not_self_parent.name: hierarchy_nodes_not_self_parent

ministry_memberships_dates.name: ministry_memberships_dates
ministry_memberships_dates.value: ended_on IS NULL OR ended_on >= started_on

team_memberships_dates.name: team_memberships_dates
team_memberships_dates.value: left_on IS NULL OR left_on >= joined_on

role_assignment_scope_arity.value: num_nonnulls(scope_person_id, scope_ministry_id, scope_team_id, scope_prayer_chain_id, scope_gathering_type_id) = CASE WHEN scope_type = 'global' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

role_assignment_branch_scope.name: role_assignment_branch_scope

role_assignment_team_scope.name: role_assignment_team_scope

role_assignment_gathering_type_scope.name: role_assignment_gathering_type_scope

journal_attachments_attached_complete.value: status <> 'attached' OR (entry_id IS NOT NULL AND attached_at IS NOT NULL)

journal_days_excuse_check.name: journal_days_excuse_check

journal_days_missed_final.name: journal_days_missed_final

journal_days_review_needs_entry.name: journal_days_review_needs_entry
journal_days_review_needs_entry.value: review_status = 'none' OR entry_id IS NOT NULL

journal_pauses_dates.name: journal_pauses_dates
journal_pauses_dates.value: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

prayer_events_via_check.name: prayer_events_via_check

prayer_assignments_not_self_substitute.name: prayer_assignments_not_self_substitute

prayer_assignments_human_resolution.name: prayer_assignments_human_resolution
prayer_assignments_human_resolution.value: status NOT IN ('missed', 'excused') OR resolved_by IS NOT NULL

prayer_schedules_dates.name: prayer_schedules_dates
prayer_schedules_dates.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

prayer_chains_dates.name: prayer_chains_dates
prayer_chains_dates.value: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

prayer_commitments_dates.name: prayer_commitments_dates
prayer_commitments_dates.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

notifications_recipient.name: notifications_recipient
notifications_recipient.value: recipient_person_id IS NOT NULL OR recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL

scheduled_jobs_status_check.name: scheduled_jobs_status_check
scheduled_jobs_status_check.value: last_status IS NULL OR last_status IN ('running', 'ok', 'error')

gathering_assignments_not_self_substitut.name: gathering_assignments_not_self_substitute
gathering_assignments_not_self_substitut.value: substitute_for_id IS NULL OR substitute_for_id <> id

gathering_schedules_rotation_anchor.value: rotation_mode = 'none' OR rotation_anchor IS NOT NULL

gathering_schedules_dates.name: gathering_schedules_dates
gathering_schedules_dates.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

gatherings_title_length.value: title IS NULL OR length(btrim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120
